steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Mission log day 184.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Currently, we are still holding fast in this run-down house.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The 184th day of the mission and the 27th day of reaching the aforementioned run-down house.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Who would believe that we've already lived in this place for 184 days.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We still have no clues about this world.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Two weeks ago, based on instructions from the locals, we left this run-down house and headed to another town.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Before we left, the townspeople said that it was a 'more developed place.' I am unsure if our definitions of developed are the same.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What happened? Turns out it was a bandit den.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No batteries, no useful information, not even a single person we could communicate normally with.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Of course, we didn't leave empty-handed. Tina 'acquired' a car.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The process was long and arduous, and used up much of what little supplies and ammunition we still had.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: However, the car was heavily damaged during the conflict, and broke down soon after we returned to the house.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Alexsandr tried to repair the car, but this car didn't have an obvious fuel intake point, and on further inspection even the fuel tank was absent.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The engine's structure was completely incomprehensible to him, to the point he wasn't even sure if it was actually an engine.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The only good news was that it was a left-hand drive car.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Having been in this world for half a year by now, we are very certain that this place is not Earth.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Stealing cars and getting into gunfights, it's like we're fugitives in a post-apocalyptic film.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Those bandits with long lizard tails didn't even need to use guns, as they were able to throw javelins weighing up to 10 kilograms to a distance tens of meters away. The term gunfight may not be accurate here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Some of them could even create huge fireballs from thin air and launch them, with the effect somewhere in between a grenade and an RPG.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: This world is far too abnormal, to the point where I'm no longer surprised by anything.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The adaptability of humans often exceeds my expectations. It seems that we will continue to struggle to survive here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Today will be the last day I'm recording. I don't plan on recording anymore.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The storage for this recorder is almost full, and the battery will not last much longer.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Our only source of power on this world is Tina's solar charger. Thank goodness this world has a sun as well.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What would happen if this charger broke, or if we used up all our supplies and ammunition?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: To be frank, I don't know.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: This situation still feels unreal to me, with everything being so weird......yet so natural.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Which way is the path back home?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Come on, Uman, look at this.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hey, you don't eat vegetables?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Let me see what else I have here......

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Haa! Come and look at Uman, my little buddy.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You're raising a......what's this called again?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Originium slug, that's what the locals call these things.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You still have the mood to raise this?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Why not? I'm spending all day sitting on the roof after all, might as well find something to do. Can't be talking to my machine gun all the time.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Your job is to keep aware of the surrounding area's safety, not play around with this snail thing.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What you've said makes sense, but what are we guarding against? Those quivering Infected, or the townsfolk living a kilometer away who never come here anyway?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The only living thing that's come close to this dump of a house is a flying lizard, which I suppose helped out with the ration issue.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ......Where's Tina and Kötz?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: They went to exchange supplies with those Infected people.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Tina managed to hunt some stuff again yesterday. She's becoming pretty experienced at it.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Tina went out to hunt by herself again?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Of course, she's even enjoying it. She's been trying to capture a wild burdenbeast.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: By the way, Kötz went to the town.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Remember that thing I dismantled from the car? Kötz said he knows a mechanic in town and wanted to ask about it.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You're too anxious, Cohen.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Just relax, we can't return anytime soon anyway.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Learn from Kötz and go talk with those people. They're somewhat friendly, at least.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I still haven't learned the local language. Man, Kötz really knows his stuff.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's what I'm afraid of.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Afraid of what?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz is getting too close to those people. It isn't a good thing, the atmosphere around here is very abnormal.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That town is too full of contradictions. We've been here for nearly a month, don't tell me you haven't picked up on that.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: A local government official who stays in his manor all day and never leaves......Oh, I guess the proper term is 'lord'? There's those fully-armed private soldiers of his as well.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: And this 'infected zone'.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The entire region is governed by the same lord, yet these Infected are not allowed to live in the town. Even the other townsfolk are unwilling to approach this place.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: They were driven here.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That's because these friends 'got a strange sickness'.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The act of separating the sick when an infectious disease is raging about is not uncommon after all, even in the past. At least the lord did not just lock them all up in prison.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Originium sickness......or was it Oripathy? I don't remember the exact term.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: All we know about this sickness is that it is related to Originium, it is infectious and it is incurable.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But how does it actually spread between people? What does it being incurable actually mean?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No one's answered our questions, and assume that we should know the basic situation.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: This disease is either common sense in this town, or it is common sense in this world.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: If it is only contact with Originium ore that will cause problems, then I don't think that it is necessary to carry out quarantine measures.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Besides, the doctor also thinks that there is no risk of infection from our frequency and distance of interaction with these Infected.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: This infected zone is just a wall-less prison, breeding hate between the Infected and the townsfolk. You can feel it even without seeing it for yourself.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The word I'm using is 'hate', not just exclusion and discrimination. Hate is carved into every word they speak, every action they do. It's become part of their culture.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Hate. You understand what I mean? This isn't just a problem about an unknown disease anymore. We shouldn't get involved in any local conflicts.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Just imagine this scenario. If the townsfolk began grabbing torches, raising pitchforks and rushing into these Infected's homes, what would you do then? Shoot them down?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hard to say.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: We have them to thank for our food, water and medicine for the past few months.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Before this, we've been trudging back and forth across this treacherous wasteland, being attacked by anything that moves and not getting even a single glimpse of civilization......until we got their help.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Do you really think we can just 'mind our own business', Cohen?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If they grabbed weapons and broke into Doctor Miarow's clinic, do you really want to just stand aside and watch?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: As for the problem you mentioned earlier, I don't think the infectiousness can be ignored.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's as if everyone in this world has undergone professional chemical warfare training. They are always covering up their nose and mouth, and being extremely sensitive about protecting their respiratory systems, no matter their age or gender.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I've repeated this point before as well, that we must prepare similar protections for ourselves......

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The doctor also approved of us keeping our distance. Thankfully the Infected don't have any complaints towards this. Perhaps this is normal to them.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What did the doctor say about this?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I didn't ask him. None of us asked him.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Every time we mention this topic, he always looks as though he would rather avoid it completely. As long as he thinks our defensive measures are fine, I won't bother him about it.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: (Shhh...)

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: 'I did not order pizza.'
There's no need to match passwords, Miss Cohen.
It's me, Miarow.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Right on cue.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Hold on, let me open the door.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Good morning, doctor.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Good morning, Miss Cohen.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Good morning, Mister Alexsandr.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Heh, we were just talking about you.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: You do realize you're raising an Originium Slug, Mister Alexsandr?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Yeah, this little thing is actually pretty fun to play with. Tina caught some earlier and this one was too small, so I kept it.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: So you came to look for Tina?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: No, I'm here to deliver stuff.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: These are medical supplies, there were more leftovers this time.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Thank you very much, doctor. We're always imposing on you.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I should be the one thanking you. It's all thanks to those Originium Slugs Miss Tina caught that we have enough painkillers for the next few months.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: So, these 'Originium Slugs' really can cure diseases?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: How do I put it...

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Oripathy is incurable......This remedy made by fermenting the body fluids of Originium Slugs can only help to relieve the pain, it cannot actually cure the disease.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: However, being able to relieve the pain is already a great blessing to the Infected. Crystallization on the skin will affect normal life, and the pain is so unbearable for some that they cannot even move.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's great that we can be of help.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: This is the book that you asked me to look for you last time. I specifically looked for one in the Ursus language.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Oh, great. Let me take a look.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Right......

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Can you understand it?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: ......With some difficulty.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: At a glance, it looks like Cyrillic.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: But when I look closer at it, there are many differences.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: At least you have something to do now, just treat it as learning a foreign language.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It should be more interesting than playing with a snail.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Speaking of language, what do you call the language we're speaking now?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Your accents are a little weird......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: But it is undoubtedly the Victorian language.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Victoria......

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What about the locals, what do they speak?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: The people here speak Sargonian, though Sargonian itself has a lot of dialects.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: For example, most Sargons can't understand the Sargonian spoken by the tribes from the rainforest in east Sargon.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's complicated.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Ursus.......Ursus.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What kind of place is Ursus?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Right......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I'm not too sure myself......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Back in school, they used to say that Ursus was in the far north and covered in snow year-round. It's ruled by a Tsar.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: But I don't know anyone who's ever been to Ursus, haha.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Tsar? ...Tch.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What's wrong, you seem disappointed.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: A little.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If I have the chance, I'd really like to take a look at this place called Ursus.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Travelling to faraway places......that sounds nice.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Perhaps only great people like you are able to do it.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: If possible, I also hope to travel to Columbia to complete my studies and become a real doctor.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Alas, I don't have that much money, and the patients here still need me.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You're still young, there's always a chance in the future.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ......Maybe.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Oh right, there's one other thing.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Please don't go outside for a while, and hide that car of yours as well.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Did something happen in town?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How did you know?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Last night, I saw the lord's soldiers patrolling by the wall. That was unusual.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Actually, the lord's soldiers have been doing night patrols in the infected zone for a week now......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Recently, monsters have been appearing in town. They've attacked many people.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Monsters?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Man, all the animals in this world are already so strange, I don't dare imagine what a monster would be like.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: The townsfolk have been complaining about the Infected lately. Do you want to move to the second floor of my clinic for a few days? The lord's soldiers will come to inspect this ruined house sooner or later.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Will it be fine, doctor? It might bring you trouble.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: You've helped me out so much, I don't think it's a big deal.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I agree with the doctor. Clashing with the lord's soldiers will just get us involved in the local issues and bring more trouble upon us.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I don't want to get into a fight with those two-meter tall dog-head people.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (Cough) Err, I'll tell you about that next time.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Someone's coming.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: 'I did not order pizza.'

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Alexsandr! Open the door!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's Tina.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Calm down, what happened?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Cohen! Trouble.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: A group of armed townsfolk are blocking the road to the infected zone, and the Infected are confronting them.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Those people are acting very aggressively, demanding that someone be handed over to them.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You see, what did I say earlier?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ......Speak of the devil......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Townsfolk? Armed?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Why? The lord's soldiers do not allow normal townsfolk to approach the infected zone.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That just means the lord's soldiers no longer have the time to care about this place anymore.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Wait! What about Kötz? Didn't Kötz go to the town this morning?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Kötz said he was going to look for a mechanic in town this morning, but he hasn't returned yet.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Oh no.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Go check it out first. At least make sure if Kötz is there.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Should we bring weapons?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ......Bring them just in case, but don't attack unless absolutely necessary.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: No! Wait.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Don't worry, let me handle it first. I'm more familiar with the townsfolk, let me negotiate with them.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ......Alright, doctor. Please be careful.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: It's fine, the townsfolk......They're reasonable.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Hand that person over!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Give us that suspicious person! All of us saw it!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: What the hell are you talking about!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't lie to us, you damn pollutants! I know all the recent happenings were you guys' doings!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: You ungrateful maggots, the lord should never have allowed you to stay! !

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I saw a large and heavily wrapped up person leave town and sneak over here earlier! Hand him over!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Fine, since you refuse to give up this false pretense, we don't need to be courteous anymore.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Everyone! Get them!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't you dare! Do you really think we're pushovers!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Everyone! They want a fight!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hey, stop! Don't fight! Let's talk first, alright?

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Wah! Mister Kötz, didn't I ask you to hide......

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It's fine, don't worry. Let me talk with them.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: This accent, you're not from here!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Who are you!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Sigh......What do I do now. )

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Blitz: I'm a merchant, one that collects trash.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Merchant? If you're a merchant, why do you have to sneak around?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: What do you have under that bulging robe of yours? Come on, show us!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Capture him! Bring him to the lord!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Fine fine fine, I'll listen to you. I'll go with you guys.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: There's no reason for us to fight, right? I'll explain clearly to your 'lord'.

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Mister Kötz......

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Capture these guys as well. I suspect they're all accomplices!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: You! Don't go too far! What right do you have to capture others!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Oh, come on.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Bro, that's pretty unreasonable of you.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: These friends just bought some Originium Slugs that I hunted. Surely it's not a crime to sell Originium Slugs?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Who knows if you people are colluding together to plan something sinister.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Capture them......capture all of them!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Stop! Are you all planning to go against Lord Tulla's will!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Doctor! You've finally come!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Ah......apologies, Doctor Miarow.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Lord Tulla ruled that no one is allowed to approach this zone, unless you are an Infected as well.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: What, are all of you Infected?

steps.name: Burly Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't bother trying to smooth-talk us. What kind of relationship do you have with this outsider? Spit it out!

steps.name: Burly Townsfolk
steps.text: Otherwise, we'll capture you as well.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: He's a patient of mine. There's no rule that my clinic cannot accept outsiders as patients.

steps.name: Burly Townsfolk
steps.text: Well then, since you want to stop me, why don't you try and see?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ......What are you planning to do?

steps.name: Strange Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't waste time here, bring them away.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ......Hold on!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: You......you're not from this town!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What do you think of it?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The doctor is trying to reason with them, but the other side are stubborn as bulls.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Doesn't seem like it can be resolved peacefully.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't be rash, let the doctor handle it.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Cohen, something's wrong.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Do you see those big guys at the back there?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I see them.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What are those things they're carrying? They're wrapped in cloth.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: With that size, it doesn't seem like they're farming tools.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Would normal farmers carry these kinds of heavy weapons?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: ......Even in this world, I don't think farmers would till the fields while carrying huge swords.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: They're not here to talk, Cohen.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't do anything stupid!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ......Both of you cover me.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Strange Townsfolk
steps.text: Brat, shut your mouth if you don't want to die.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: You're not from here.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I've never seen you before. Who are you people!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: What are you planning to do here!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Huh, you guys are just like thieves crying 'stop thief'!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Guards! There are intruders here! Guards!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Everyone! There are intruders!

steps.name: Strange Townsfolk
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Strange Townsfolk
steps.text: You talk too much.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Time to shut up.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Doctor, get down!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Guns!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: They're mercenaries!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Why are there mercenaries in the infected zone?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Don't worry about it. We have to bring them all back, dead or alive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Do it.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Lord! Cover fire!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Should have done so from the start.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Taste this (Russian profanity)!
